verdict: Maybe. Beyond Water pitched India's first liquid water enhancer on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. The product is light and cheap to ship compared with bottled drinks, which solves beverages' biggest cost problem. But buyers need to be taught what it is and why they need it.
angle: A few drops add flavour and vitamins to plain water, which appeals to people trying to drink more water without sugar. It ships in small bottles, so freight is much cheaper than for ready-to-drink beverages. Education, sampling and gym or office partnerships are how buyers discover it.
